title.narrative: ROAP/AFG03/22Emergency Support Programme for Conflict-Displaced Afghans

description.narrative:
Building on the community-centered People’s Process, the proposed action will utilize a community-centered approach to upgrade basic services and infrastructure for highly vulnerable displaced people living in urban informal settlements in the cities of Kabul and Herat.
The Overall Objective is to provide lifesaving services and infrastructure to meet the immediate needs of vulnerable, displaced urban residents, build their long-term resilience to shocks, and contribute to sustainable development and peacebuilding.
The Specific Objective is to upgrade key infrastructure and services for 50,000 IDPs and returnees in informal settlements in Kabul and Herat.
Below are summarised the key outputs/activities associated with the three outcomes. These activities will be implemented over the actions 12 month implementation period. The details of implementation sequencing can be found in the project work plan and logframe (attached as separate document), which also includes yearly targets to monitor the progression of project activities.
Activity 1: Spatial and community-based planning: (a) identify the needs of 50,000 vulnerable displaced people, focusing on the needs of women, youth and the disabled; (b) plan lifesaving WASH, services and community infrastructure investments A.1.1: City-scale spatial and socioeconomic assessment of urban vulnerability and capacities A.1.2: Community-scale spatial and socioeconomic assessment of urban vulnerability and capacities A.1.3: Development of settlement plans for humanitarian investments in services and infrastructure
Activity 2: Implement community-based upgrading of WASH, services and community infrastructure for 50,000 people most in need using a cash-for-work implementation modality A.2.1: Investments in lifesaving humanitarian services and infrastructure according to A.1.3 plans A.2.2: Provision and administration of cash-for-work to implement A.2.1 A.2.3: Capacity building of CDCs and GAs to implement A.2.2
Activity 3: Provision of spatial planning tools and data to enable coordinated humanitarian response (UN and NGO) for the effective, efficient distribution of lifesaving aid A.3.1 Trainings and workshops for humanitarian agencies and community-based organisations on community spatial planning tools developed through project A.3.2 Draft and publish Strategic Plan with partners with inputs facilitated through A.3.1
